integrity: Mathematical proof reconstructed from the stated assumptions; tests are finite corroboration; no external validation or novelty guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Only a uniformly coupled one-excitation finite ring with uniform gauge flux and strictly positive Markovian local losses. Finite flux mistuning, onsite/hopping disorder, multiple excitations and extra noise channels need separate analysis. Zero-flux ring trapping is prior art; implicit broader spectral coverage and a relevant abstract-only recent manuscript remain priority risks.
title: Flux-gated dark-mode arithmetic and perfect antipodal trapping on lossy quantum rings
